messages:
Alex C: Quick FYI — HelixBridge SI reported failed post-install connectivity to our private registry after image pull. customer hit during validation.
Priya N: Thanks. Miguel, can you triage network egress rules? They said 403 from gcr.redwood-inference.net
Miguel R: On it. Can you paste the exact curl + headers Sam used? different certs sometimes.
Sam (HelixBridge): curl -v https://gcr.redwood-inference.net/helixtest:v2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -> 403. No proxy in front.
Miguel R: Looks like token error or registry IP blocked. Sophie, did we recently rotate registry ACLs for the marketplace image upload job?
Sophie L: We rotated keys last night for the publisher pipeline, but ACLs were stable. I’ll check audit logs.
Sophie L: audit log: 2026-02-11T03:12Z principal=publisher-ci action=upload image=helixtest:v2 succeeded. No deny events.
Miguel R: Ok that suggests request reaches registry but auth fails for SI token. Priya, which token flow did HelixBridge use? OAuth or marketplace signed token?
Priya N: HelixBridge uses marketplace-signed install token. I asked DevEx to confirm token issuer and TTL.
deploy-bot: build/helixtest:v2 pushed to registry at 2026-02-11T03:10Z by publisher-ci
Alex C: Sam, can you try a curl with verbose and include --trace-ascii output? Also try with the marketplace token I just DM'd you.
Sam (HelixBridge): Trying now, will paste output in a sec.
Sam (HelixBridge): Trace shows 401 Unauthorized, header x-registry-err: token_expired
Miguel R: token_expired — suggests time skew or short TTL. Sophie, marketplace token TTL for signed installs?
Sophie L: Current TTL = 10m for install tokens (we generate ephemeral). We had a bug that sometimes encoded iat incorrectly in UTC offset. Investigating.
Priya N: If token TTL shorter than install walkthrough steps they follow, it'll expire before pull. As workaround tell them to re-run install immediately after fetching token.
Alex C: Short-term remediation: Miguel can add a temporary allowlist for HelixBridge's runner IPs for 12h to let them finish validation.
Miguel R: Will open firewall rule — adding 54.211.22.0/24 for 12h. Patch id: FW-3129. Noted.
Sophie L: Patch to token issuer queued: fix iat encoding. ETA 4h. Will monitor.
Priya N: I'll update HelixBridge PM: recommend re-run install, provide DM token flow, and we will keep the IP allowlist for 12h. Also scheduling a joint call in 30m to watch a validation run.
Sam (HelixBridge): Thanks — we'll standby for the call and re-run once you confirm firewall rule.
Alex C: Thanks team. Follow-up: Sophie to confirm token patch and postmortem item; Miguel to remove allowlist after 12h; Priya to run the go-live runbook step update.
Miguel R: Done — firewall rule applied. FW-3129 open.
Sophie L: Will post remediation PR + changelog entry once merged.
Priya N: Scheduling call now: invites sent to Sam, Miguel, Sophie, Alex.
Alex C: Closing thread for now. Ping here with any regression. :thumbsup:
